verdict.rationale: Bevy is a Rust game engine and app framework used as a normal Rust dependency. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers is an agent or assistant role, not a game-engine axis. The only MCP-related evidence is community tooling (bevy_brp, built on the Bevy Remote Protocol) that exposes Bevy to agents. That is the server side, so it does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
